# Crossplane XRD + Composition for Versioned Web App Infrastructure

Below is a complete Crossplane implementation using function-patch-and-transform mode to provision the canonical scenario (S3, RDS, IAM) with environment-aware configuration.

## 1. Composite Resource Definition (XRD)

```yaml
# xrd-webappinfra.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: webappinfras.spine.example.com
spec:
  group: spine.example.com
  names:
    kind: WebAppInfra
    plural: webappinfras
  claimNames:
    kind: WebAppInfraClaim
    plural: webappinfraclaims
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            required:
            - environment
            - region
            - bucketName
            - dbName
            properties:
              environment:
                type: string
                enum: [dev, prod]
                description: "Deployment environment (dev or prod)"
              region:
                type: string
                description: "AWS region"
              bucketName:
                type: string
                description: "S3 bucket name (must be globally unique)"
              dbName:
                type: string
                description: "RDS database name"
              dbUsername:
                type: string
                default: "postgres"
                description: "RDS master username"
              enableReplication:
                type: boolean
                default: false
                description: "Enable cross-region replication (prod only)"
              replicationRegion:
                type: string
                default: "us-west-2"
                description: "Target region for S3 replication"
          status:
            type: object
            properties:
              bucketArn:
                type: string
              bucketRegionalDomainName:
                type: string
              dbEndpoint:
                type: string
              roleArn:
                type: string
```

## 2. Composition with Function-Patch-and-Transform

```yaml
# composition-webappinfra.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: webappinfra-aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: spine.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: WebAppInfra
  mode: Functions
  functions:
  - step: patch-and-transform
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      resources:
      # ===== S3 Bucket =====
      - name: s3-bucket
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Bucket
          metadata:
            name: s3-bucket-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              bucket: placeholder
              serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
              - rule:
                - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                  - sseAlgorithm: AES256
              versioningConfiguration:
              - status: Enabled
              publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
              - blockPublicAcls: true
                blockPublicPolicy: true
                ignorePublicAcls: true
                restrictPublicBuckets: true
            providerConfigRef:
              name: default
        connectionDetails:
        - fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          name: bucketArn
        - fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.regionName
          name: bucketRegion
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels[environment]
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          toFieldPath: status.bucketArn
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.regionName
          toFieldPath: status.bucketRegionalDomainName
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "%s.s3.amazonaws.com"

      # ===== S3 Bucket Replication Configuration (Prod Only) =====
      - name: s3-replication
        base:
          apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: BucketReplicationConfiguration
          metadata:
            name: s3-replication-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              bucketRef:
                name: placeholder
              role: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/s3-replication-role"
              region: us-east-1
              replicationConfiguration:
              - role: "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/s3-replication-role"
                rules:
                - destination:
                  - bucket: "arn:aws:s3:::placeholder"
                    replicationTime:
                    - status: Enabled
                      time:
                      - minutes: 15
                  filter:
                    prefix: ""
                  id: "replicate-all"
                  status: Enabled
            providerConfigRef:
              name: default
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.enableReplication
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[skip]
          transforms:
          - type: bool
            bool:
              invert: true
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.replicationRegion
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.replicationConfiguration[0].rules[0].destination[0].bucket
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "arn:aws:s3:::$(bucketName)-replica"

      # ===== RDS Security Group =====
      - name: rds-security-group
        base:
          apiVersion: ec2.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: SecurityGroup
          metadata:
            name: rds-sg-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              description: "Security group for RDS PostgreSQL"
              vpcId: vpc-placeholder
            providerConfigRef:
              name: default
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels[environment]

      # ===== RDS PostgreSQL Instance =====
      - name: rds-postgres
        base:
          apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Instance
          metadata:
            name: postgres-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              region: us-east-1
              engine: postgres
              engineVersion: "14"
              instanceClass: db.t3.micro
              allocatedStorage: "20"
              storageType: gp2
              storageEncrypted: true
              dbName: placeholder
              username: postgres
              passwordSecretRef:
                name: rds-password
                namespace: crossplane-system
                key: password
              deletionProtection: true
              backupRetentionPeriod: 7
              backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
              maintenanceWindow: "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"
              multiAz: false
              publiclyAccessible: false
              skipFinalSnapshot: false
              finalSnapshotIdentifierPrefix: "postgres-snapshot"
              vpcSecurityGroupIdRefs:
              - name: rds-sg-placeholder
              enableCloudwatchLogsExports:
              - postgresql
            providerConfigRef:
              name: default
        connectionDetails:
        - fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
          name: dbEndpoint
        - fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
          name: dbAddress
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbName
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "postgres-%s"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.dbUsername
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels[environment]
        # Environment-specific instance sizing
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
          transforms:
          - type: map
            map:
              dev: db.t3.micro
              prod: db.t3.medium
        # Multi-AZ only for prod
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
          transforms:
          - type: map
            map:
              dev: "false"
              prod: "true"
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
          toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint

      # ===== IAM Role (Service Account) =====
      - name: iam-role
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: Role
          metadata:
            name: webapp-service-role-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": {
                        "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PLACEHOLDER"
                      },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                      "Condition": {
                        "StringEquals": {
                          "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PLACEHOLDER:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:webapp"
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: default
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "webapp-service-role-%s"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels[environment]
        - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
          toFieldPath: status.roleArn

      # ===== IAM Policy (S3 + RDS Access) =====
      - name: iam-policy
        base:
          apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
          kind: RolePolicy
          metadata:
            name: webapp-policy-placeholder
          spec:
            forProvider:
              roleRef:
                name: placeholder
              policy: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Sid": "S3BucketAccess",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:PutObject",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": [
                        "arn:aws:s3:::placeholder",
                        "arn:aws:s3:::placeholder/*"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "rds-db:connect"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:*:*:db/placeholder"
                    }
                  ]
                }
            providerConfigRef:
              name: default
        patches:
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "webapp-policy-%s"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: "webapp-service-role-%s"
        - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
          fromFieldPath: spec.bucketName
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
          transforms:
          - type: string
            string:
              fmt: |
                {
                  "Version": "2012-10-17",
                  "Statement": [
                    {
                      "Sid": "S3BucketAccess",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "s3:GetObject",
                        "s3:PutObject",
                        "s3:ListBucket"
                      ],
                      "Resource": [
                        "arn:aws:s3:::%s",
                        "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"
                      ]
                    },
                    {
                      "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Action": [
                        "rds-db:connect"
                      ],
                      "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:*:*:db/placeholder"
                    }
                  ]
                }
```

## 3. Environment-Specific Claims

```yaml
# claim-dev.yaml
apiVersion: spine.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: WebAppInfraClaim
metadata:
  name: webapp-dev
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  environment: dev
  region: us-east-1
  bucketName: webapp-assets-dev-20260827
  dbName: appdb-dev
  dbUsername: postgres
  enableReplication: false
  compositionRef:
    name: webappinfra-aws

---
# claim-prod.yaml
apiVersion: spine.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: WebAppInfraClaim
metadata:
  name: webapp-prod
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  environment: prod
  region: us-east-1
  bucketName: webapp-assets-prod-20260827
  dbName: appdb-prod
  dbUsername: postgres
  enableReplication: true
  replicationRegion: us-west-2
  compositionRef:
    name: webappinfra-aws
```

## 4. Key Features Implemented

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **S3 Versioning** | `versioningConfiguration.status: Enabled` |
| **S3 Encryption** | `serverSideEncryptionConfiguration` with AES256 |
| **S3 No Public Access** | `publicAccessBlockConfiguration` (all true) |
| **RDS Deletion Protection** | `deletionProtection: true` |
| **RDS Backup Retention** | `backupRetentionPeriod: 7` (adjustable) |
| **RDS Encryption** | `storageEncrypted: true` |
| **RDS Not Public** | `publiclyAccessible: false` |
| **RDS Multi-AZ (Prod)** | `map` transform: dev=false, prod=true |
| **IAM Least Privilege** | Scoped S3 and RDS actions; OIDC trust for prod |
| **Environment Isolation** | Separate claims; labels; sized per env |
| **S3 Replication (Prod)** | `BucketReplicationConfiguration` (skipped for dev) |

## 5. Provider Configuration

```yaml
# provider-config.yaml
apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: default
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds
      key: creds
  assumeRole:
    roleARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/crossplane-controller
```

---

**Deployment:**

```bash
kubectl apply -f xrd-webappinfra.yaml
kubectl apply -f provider-config.yaml
kubectl apply -f composition-webappinfra.yaml
kubectl apply -f claim-dev.yaml claim-prod.yaml
```

Monitor with:
```bash
kubectl get webappinfraclaims
kubectl describe webappinfraclaim webapp-dev
kubectl get managed
```
